shared_rule: Preserve the approved pose-class base identity, outfit or drape, anatomy, pose, camera, crop, lighting and background; change only the requested facial state.

expressions.ward/afraid: wide eyes, tense brows, slight blush and one sweat drop
expressions.ward/crying: quiet tears with a trembling mouth
expressions.intraoperative/pain: eyes squeezed shut in acute pain
expressions.intraoperative/near_collapse: awake but exhausted and nearly collapsing
expressions.intraoperative/anesthetized: eyes fully closed, peaceful relaxed face
expressions.operating_table/afraid: clearly afraid, serious rather than comedic
expressions.operating_table/anesthetized: eyes fully closed and relaxed; no mask in this slot
expressions.operating_table_lithotomy/afraid: clearly afraid, serious rather than comedic
expressions.operating_table_lithotomy/anesthetized: user-supplied replacement: eyes closed under general anesthesia with a transparent mask and corrugated breathing tube

second_equivalent_attempt.description: Simplified to a peaceful closed-eye facial-state change while preserving the same approved SFW scene.
